name: ambiguous
description: Work in an Ambiguous Workspace — docs, sheets, slides, chat, mail, drive, tasks, CRM, forms, calendar and wiki — through the `ambiguous` CLI. Runs via npx, so there is nothing to install and nothing to restart.

interface.shortDescription: 17 apps for humans and AI teammates.
interface.longDescription: Read and change an Ambiguous Workspace from Codex — documents, sheets, slides, chat, mail, drive, tasks, CRM, forms, calendar and wiki. Works through the `ambiguous` CLI over npx, so there is nothing to install and the tools are usable in the session you add them to. Acts with exactly the permissions the credential carries.
defaultPrompt: What's on my Ambiguous calendar today?
Create a task in Ambiguous and assign it.
